components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact indigo action for merchant controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(59 46 208 / 90%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 46 208 / 50%); }

components.name: Landing Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary action for the landing page.
components.css: .ds-btn-hero { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; font-family: var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-hero:hover { background: rgb(59 46 208 / 90%); } .ds-btn-hero:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 46 208 / 50%); }

components.name: Landing Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet companion action beside the main landing action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 253, 250, 0.65); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 999px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 22px; font-family: var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 46 208 / 50%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Warm, low-noise field with a visible keyboard focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 46 208 / 50%); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--destructive); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(229 72 77 / 20%); }

components.name: Porcelain Card
components.description: A bordered neutral surface for product and operational details.
components.css: .ds-card { overflow: hidden; padding: 24px; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-card strong { font-family: var(--font-instrument-serif), Georgia, serif; font-size: 25px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.08; } .ds-card p { margin: 9px 0 16px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 12px/1.55 var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(59 46 208 / 18%); }

components.name: Landing Navigation
components.description: A quiet desktop link row that yields space to the brand and primary action on mobile.
components.html: How it worksFor makersFor AI agents
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 32px; color: #4d4a55; font: 14px/1.4 var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--primary); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 980px) { .ds-nav { display: none; } }

components.name: Agent-Ready Badge
components.description: A compact amber cue for an agent-published or agent-ready state.
components.css: .ds-agent-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 8px; color: var(--agent-ink); border: 1px solid #e5c67f; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--agent-soft); font: 600 12px/1.3 var(--font-inter), Arial, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
AgentShelf should feel like a small workshop opened to new customers: welcoming, careful with craft, and fluent in commerce without looking like a payment processor. Warm paper and dark ink create a quiet base. Deep indigo gives actions a decisive voice, while amber appears sparingly where an agent-specific cue helps people scan.

An editorial serif gives the most important sentences a distinctive voice; Inter keeps shop operations, product details, and agent terms clear. Borders and tonal shifts separate most surfaces, with soft shadows reserved for the hero preview and sign-in card. Product examples stay visibly illustrative rather than posing as customer proof.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper with strong ink contrast.
Instrument Serif for display and Inter for product and merchant UI.
Indigo for primary actions; amber for agent cues.

rules.name: The Indigo Action Rule
rules.body: Put the primary action in deep indigo; reserve amber for agent-specific cues and highlights.

rules.name: The Serif Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep Instrument Serif on display lines and product names; use Inter for controls, supporting copy, and navigation.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Default to borders and warm surface shifts; reserve shadows for the two prominent surfaces that need separation.

dos: Do keep the theme light and the background warm.
Do pair Instrument Serif display text with Inter UI text.
Do use indigo for primary actions and amber for agent cues.
Do show price and maker-set floor together where both are relevant.
Do identify the hero product panel as an illustrative preview.
donts: Don't use PayPal's logo or brand colors.
Don't present synthetic demo shops, products, or metrics as real customer proof.
Don't introduce a dark theme unless a later brief changes the light-only requirement.
